model: Exact expected prey counts for one predator without prey replacement,under the Rogers random-predator working equation N_e=N_0*(1-exp(a*(h*N_e-T))). Attack coefficient ais positive,handling time h>=0,and0<=N_e<=min(N_0,T/h)when h>0. Observations have common duration T. There is no prey reproduction or unobserved prey loss. This depletion model is different from the constant-prey-density approximation N_e=a*N_0*T/(1+a*h*N_0). Counts here are continuous expectations,not rounded integer observations.
target: Infer aand h,return the physically admissible predicted consumption at initial count10and T=1day,and the constant-density shortcut prediction for the same parameters. Report whether those predictions agree. The implicit model root must satisfy the depletion and handling constraints.

provenance.kind: Explicit small synthetic benign scientific model;data are conditional exact counts/means and do not establish empirical ecological,causal or functional claims.
